What GPA do I need to keep the Merit Excellence Scholarship?

To renew the Merit Excellence Scholarship each year, you must maintain a cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher and complete at least 24 credits in the academic year. Renewal is reviewed automatically in June, and no application is required.

Source: Merit Excellence Scholarship – Renewal Requirements (Article 000001004)
What do I need to renew the Graduate Research Scholarship?

To renew the Graduate Research Scholarship, you must submit an annual progress report signed by your research advisor. The report is due by 30 April each year. There is no GPA threshold for renewal of this scholarship.

Source: Graduate Research Scholarship – Renewal Requirements (Article 000001006)
When is the STEM Futures deadline?

The application deadline for the STEM Futures Scholarship is 15 February at 23:59 local time.

Source: STEM Futures Scholarship – Application Deadline (Article 000001005)
When is the Arts and Humanities deadline?

The application deadline for the Arts & Humanities Scholarship is 1 March. The application must include a portfolio of 10 works.

Source: Arts & Humanities Scholarship – Application Deadline (Article 000001002)
What documents do international students need for their scholarship?

International students applying for the International Student Scholarship need to provide a valid passport, proof of English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 or higher), and a financial statement showing how remaining costs will be covered.

Source: International Student Scholarship – Required Documents (Article 000001001)
What documents do I need for an athletic scholarship?

A recommendation from the team coach, an NCAA eligibility certificate, and a medical clearance form from a licensed physician are required for an athletic scholarship.

Source: Athletic Scholarship – Required Documents (Article 000001011)
Who is eligible for the need-based grant?

Undergraduate students are eligible for the Need-Based Opportunity Grant if they submit the FAFSA and their family income is up to $60,000 a year. There is no GPA threshold. The grant is reassessed each year based on the new FAFSA.

Source: Need-Based Opportunity Grant – Eligibility (Article 000001000)
Is work-study a scholarship?

Federal Work-Study is not a scholarship. It is need-based part-time employment for undergraduate and graduate students with financial need. Eligibility requires the FAFSA, and students may work up to 20 hours a week during the term.

Source: Federal Work-Study – Eligibility (Article 000001009)
